blocks.hero.eyebrow: Southern Indiana · In person in Louisville
blocks.hero.subhead: Freedom Counseling Services is just across the river in Louisville's Middletown area, about a 20-minute drive from New Albany, Jeffersonville, and Clarksville. Southern Indiana clients meet with us in person at our office.

facts.text: Choose your counselor, or let us match you

blocks.request.heading: Ready to start, just across the river?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment in about a minute, or call (502) 523-2970. Most people are seen the same week.

sections.heading: Closer than you might think
sections.body: A Kentucky counselor doesn't have to mean a long trip. Our office sits just off I-64 near Blankenbaker Parkway, about 20 minutes from New Albany, Jeffersonville, Clarksville, and Watson. For many Southern Indiana clients, it's an easy drive after work or on a lunch break.

sections.heading: Why sessions are in person for Indiana clients
sections.body: Our counselors are licensed in Kentucky. The law requires a counselor to be licensed in the state where you are during a session, so we can't meet with Indiana clients online. When you come to our Louisville office, you're in Kentucky, and we can work with you fully, with the same counselors and the same care as every client.

blocks.links.heading: What Southern Indiana clients come to us for

links.items.title: Individual counseling
links.items.text: For anxiety, depression, OCD, or a season of feeling stuck

links.items.title: Christian counseling
links.items.text: For anyone who wants faith at the center

blocks.faith.heading: Faith at the center, never forced
blocks.faith.body: Freedom brings together a biblical worldview, Christian theology, and the best clinical practice. If you'd rather not bring faith into your counseling, you'll get the same excellent care, and your counselor will follow your lead.
blocks.team.heading: Choose your counselor
blocks.team.note: Every counselor is accepting new clients.
blocks.office.heading: Finding our office
blocks.office.directions: Just off Blankenbaker Parkway, across from Southeast Christian Church, in the office complex behind Heine Brothers Coffee. Parking is right outside.
blocks.expect.heading: Your first visit
blocks.expect.body: Your first session is mostly a conversation: your counselor getting to know you and what brought you in. There's nothing to prepare. Sessions are 50 minutes.
blocks.cost.heading: What it costs
blocks.cost.body: $50 to $160 per session, depending on your counselor, the same as for every client. We don't bill insurance, but we'll give you a superbill to submit for possible out-of-network reimbursement.
